[B2] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'leave' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < Device | 'buttonPressed' : false , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' Device
=> < Device | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'key' : Key , ... > < UserY | 'key' : Key , ... > < Device | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'sendKey' Device | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'key' : Key , ... > < UserY | 'key' : Key , ... > < Device | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'discover' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > $ Device 'bind' cloudA | (Key) .
[B5] < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | Device : ('owner' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ Device 'bind' cloudA | (Key)
=> < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | Device : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > .
